content.title: ALGM Q2 Deep Dive: Automotive and Data Center Demand Offset Margin Pressures
content.summary: Chip designer Allegro MicroSystems (NASDAQ:ALGM) reported Q2 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 21.9% year on year to $203.4 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $210 million at the midpoint, 1.4% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP loss of $0.07 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
